title: Cellular Metabolism and Efficient Utilization of Microbial Oils
summary: This cluster revolves around cellular metabolism and the efficient utilization of microbial oils. Malia PC Ungermann C Vacuole membrane contact sites are involved in various processes, including cellular metabolism, domains, emerging hubs, and organelle function. Murley is associated with ER-localized sterol transport and ER-mitochondria and ER-vacuole contacts. The production of microbial oils is linked to biodiesel production, and efficient utilization produces lignocellulosic materials. Various methods and tools, such as Ratledge C Yeasts and Sci Rep, are used to achieve these processes.
